lines.text: Hello, am I speaking with the owner of [Business Name]?
Could I speak with the owner? I have some research data about their business I wanted to share directly with them.
Hi! My name is Afifa, I'm calling from FortuneMarq Media & Marketing — we're a digital growth agency based right here in [City].
Sir, should I continue in Kannada, Hindi, or English? Whatever is comfortable for you.
I just need 2 minutes of your time — we've done some market research specifically for [Niche] businesses in [City], and the numbers are quite interesting. Is this a good time?

objections.response: No problem at all. Can I call you back in an hour or later this evening?
No worries. Mind if I ask — is there a specific reason you don't want to do digital marketing for your business?

lines.text: Every month, [Search Volume] people in [City] search for [Niche] on Google.
[PAUSE 2 seconds] That's [Search Volume] potential customers — every single month — actively looking for exactly what you offer.

objections.trigger: Those numbers don't sound right / You're exaggerating
objections.response: Sir, this data comes directly from Google Keyword Planner — the same tool companies like Swiggy and Amazon use for their market research. I can share a screenshot on WhatsApp right now if you'd like.
That's really good to hear. What we found might still be useful — it shows how much more is available online that isn't reaching you right now. Worth knowing even if things are going well.

lines.text: You have a website — which is a good start. But it is not showing up when people search for [Niche] in [City]. That means [Search Volume] people every month are searching, finding your competitors, and not even seeing [Business Name].

The website exists — it's just not working for you yet. And that's a fixable problem. Right now most businesses in your niche in [City] haven't fixed it either — so there's a real window to move first.

objections.trigger: But I do have a website already
objections.response: Yes — and that puts you ahead of businesses that don't have one at all. But having a website and having a website that ranks on Google are two different things. The 15-minute call will show you exactly what it would take to get it working.

lines.text: We help local [Niche] businesses show up on Google directly — not through JustDial, not through directories. Your own website, your own Google ranking, your own enquiries coming straight to you.
We've built this system specifically for local businesses in [City]. Everything is connected — the website, the SEO, the Google presence — and we manage it so you don't have to.

To understand this better — our founder personally does a quick Zoom call, which you can join right from your phone. He'll walk you through a presentation designed specifically for your business in [City], showing your website's current position and what it would take to start capturing those [Search Volume] monthly searches. It's 15 to 20 minutes max — and even if you don't take any services, you'll have a much clearer picture of what's possible.
When would you be free? I'll book the Zoom call and send you the link on WhatsApp.

lines.condition: If wants to think / see something first
lines.text: Absolutely — I'll send you the report on WhatsApp right now so you can have a look. And whenever you're ready, we'll set up the Zoom call with our founder.
It's completely free, no commitment at all. Our founder just walks you through your data — you decide if there's anything worth acting on.

objections.response: We don't have fixed prices — our founder first understands your business, what you actually need, and how much you can benefit from the work. Pricing is decided based on that. But I can assure you, nobody in Hubli right now offers pricing like ours. You can discuss everything directly with him on the call.

objections.trigger: We tried digital marketing before and it didn't work
objections.response: That happens a lot — most agencies just run ads with no foundation underneath. What we do is different: we build the whole system first. The Zoom call is the best way to show you what that difference looks like in practice.

objections.trigger: The owner isn't available / Someone else handles this
objections.response: No problem — when is the owner usually free? Our founder can speak directly with them. Or I can WhatsApp the report first so they can have a look before we set up the call.

objections.trigger: Just send me information on WhatsApp
objections.response: Of course — I'll send the report right now. Have a look whenever you get a chance, and then the Zoom call with our founder will make a lot more sense. I'll follow up in a couple of days.
Absolutely, take your time. I'll send the report on WhatsApp and follow up in a couple of days — no pressure. The Zoom call is free, no commitment, our founder just walks you through the data.

objections.trigger: We handle marketing internally / We have someone
objections.response: Good to know. The Zoom call might still be useful — our founder can show you what the market data says and you can see if there are gaps worth filling. Even as a second opinion, most business owners find it valuable.
